title: ‘GTA 6’ live updates: Record $3.8 billion launch, viral clips and the secrets players are finding in Leonida - Yahoo Tech
description: GTA 6 had a record $3.79 billion launch day. Players are now finding Easter eggs, celebrity cameos and hidden tributes across Leonida.

title: GOP set to block Trump Pentagon picks as other military moves face headwinds - The Washington Post
description: Senate Republicans won’t advance two political nominees for key policy jobs. The administration’s nominees to lead the Army and Navy also have encountered resistance, as has its ask for hundreds of billions of dollars in defense funding.

title: Federal jury convicts man of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles - NPR
description: Prosecutors argued the defendant, 30-year-old Jonathan Rinderknecht, had been "mad at everything" in the days leading up to the January 2025 fire, which killed 12 people.

title: Trump calling Putin ‘my friend’ at APEC summit sparks backlash - NBC News
description: When President Donald Trump called Vladimir Putin his “friend” this week, European leaders and foreign policy experts were dismayed and alarmed.
